A complete, ground-up dark-mode rework: a clean, sleek, **fully dark UI** — monochrome IBM Carbon `#161616` across the *entire* JDownloader interface (download list, link grabber **and** settings, not just the menu bar) in a borderless, maximised kiosk window — genuinely turnkey (auto-install, auto-confirmed prompts, self-healing theme), with downloads correctly landing in your mapped `/downloads` share and all settings, links and session state persisted in `/config` across image updates.

## ✨ Added

- **Native, race-free dark theme** — JDownloader's own `colorfor*` palette (Carbon `#161616`) for all content areas, a **patched FlatLaf** (`flatlaf.jar`) for the window chrome, and the bundled **flat icon set** — re-applied on every launch. Switch to a matching Light theme any time with the `JD_THEME` variable.
- **Theme auto-heal** — JDownloader resets its theme when it self-installs/updates; the container detects this and restarts JD once so the full dark theme is re-applied automatically (bounded, no restart loops).
- **`JDOWNLOADER IS READY` log banner** — printed on **every** container start, and **only** once JD is up *and* the dark theme is applied, so it never appears while the UI is still rendering. On the first start (and after every image update) JDownloader installs/updates itself, so the WebUI stays black for a few minutes — watch the container log and open the WebUI only after the banner; don't restart the container during the install.
- **Column-layout persistence** — hidden columns, sort order and widths now survive a `docker restart`/stop: the JVM is shut down gracefully so JD can flush its settings, and the autostart loop is stopped *before* the JVM is terminated so it can't relaunch JD mid-shutdown and re-open the settings-corruption window.
- **Auto-confirmed install dialogs** — a tiny `-javaagent` clicks JDownloader's forced first-run install prompts for you; nothing to click.
- **HTTPS WebUI by default** (port `3001`) for **seamless two-way browser clipboard**, plus a proper browser-tab favicon.
- **Kiosk window** — borderless, maximised JD window; dialogs (e.g. *Add premium account*) float at their natural size instead of being maximised.
- **Boot smoke-test gate.** CI boots the built image and waits for the KasmVNC WebUI *and* the JDownloader JVM launch before publishing `:latest` (SIGPIPE-safe). A build that compiles but can't start can no longer reach the published tag.
- **App screenshots in the README** and a versioned support-thread template (`.github/SUPPORT_THREAD.*`).
- **`JD_THEME` variable**, replacing `JD_DARK_MODE true/false` — theme name is set directly (`JD_Plain_Dark`, `JD_Plain`, `JDDEFAULT`), with the Unraid template showing a dropdown defaulting to `JD_Plain_Dark`.
- **ASCII banner in the init log** — a consistent "Junker der Provinz" banner on every container start.
- **`generate-assets.yml` workflow** — converts `icon.svg` to `icon.png` (256×256) for Community Applications.

## 🎨 Design

- New house banner; CA icon on a solid white background.
- Download list: **uniform rows** (no alternating stripes), darkening only on mouse-over; progress bars use **light fills with readable text**, and the speed-meter graph stays green.

## ⚡ Improved

- Dark mode reworked from the earlier agent-based approach to JD's native `colorfor*` + a patched `flatlaf.jar` — **no** fragile runtime colour agent and **no** boot-classpath NPE. The old JVM dark-theme agent (a colour thread plus a dialog-auto-confirm thread) is gone; its job is done natively now.
- **Default UI language is now English** (was German). It is seeded only on the first run, so a language picked in JDownloader's own menu (Settings → the flag icon) persists across restarts; `JD_LANG` sets only JD's UI locale (via `WTFLocale.json`) without exporting a `LANG`/`LC_ALL` for a locale the image doesn't generate.
- The LinuxServer base-image branding / donate line is removed from the init log, so only this image's banner shows.
- The Unraid Community Applications template now lives in the shared [`unraid-docker-templates`](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/unraid-docker-templates) feed (one CA submission for all apps), `<Support>` points at the Unraid forum support thread, and the template Overview is tighter — leading with the dark mode and full two-way clipboard support.
- `release.yml` now supports manual changelog files under `.github/release-notes/<version>.md`.
- Template: removed `system` from the language dropdown (was an edge case with no practical use).

## 🐛 Fixed

- **JDownloader now launches reliably.** A SIGHUP from `openbox-autostart` could kill the launcher before the JVM started, leaving the WebUI black — the launcher no longer traps it.
- **Downloads now land in the mapped `/downloads` share.** On a fresh install JDownloader wrote to its built-in `/config/JDownloader/downloads` (inside appdata) and ignored the mapped volume — no matter what host path the template used. Two causes: the default download folder was never set, and (the real one) a Docker-auto-created `/downloads` host path is owned `root:root`, which the container user can't write, so JD silently fell back to appdata. The container now **seeds `/downloads` as the default download folder** and **chowns `/downloads` (and `/config`) to the actual PUID/PGID** — after LinuxServer's user remap, so on Unraid the real PUID 99 is used, not the build-time UID — and verifies writability against them, with a clear log warning if the path is still not writable.
- **Account-Manager traffic bar** no longer flickers to an unreadable light-on-light state.
- Removed the window title bar (kiosk); File/Settings/Extras menus no longer close on mouse-release under KasmVNC.
- **Truthful lint** — ShellCheck/pyflakes no longer pass through with `|| true`, and now cover the autostart + s6 `run`/`finish` scripts; one real finding (SC2011) fixed.
- **Black WebUI fixed** — `autostart` used `[[` (bash-specific), but openbox runs it with `/bin/sh`. Replaced with POSIX-compatible `[`.
- **First-run timeout increased** from 60 seconds to 5 minutes, giving JDownloader enough time to self-install on first start.
- **Force-Update reset fix** — containers installed via `wget` to a filename without the `my-` prefix ended up with a duplicate template that confused dockerMan, silently resetting settings on Force Update. The README install command now writes to `my-JDownloader.xml` directly; existing users can remove the lowercase duplicate once. The template's `<Network>`/`<TemplateURL>` tags (needed for Force Update to preserve customizations) were also restored.
- Fixed a known limitation from the earlier agent-based theme: JD's link grabber renderer (`ExtTable`) cached its background colour at component-creation time and never picked up the dark theme in the content area — resolved outright by this release's native `colorfor*` theming.

Existing containers: Force Update is enough. `/config` is left untouched. If you had `JD_DARK_MODE=true` set previously, the template updates to `JD_THEME=JD_Plain_Dark` on next open — functionally identical.
